notes: Desktop unit, not rack-mountable (two mounting holes on the bottom for surface/wall mount instead). Also sold/listed as "StarTech.com Gigabit Ethernet Fiber Media Converter - MM LC" and at retail as "Gigabit Multi-Mode LC Fiber Converter, 550m, TAA". Fiber port ships with a fixed 850nm MM SFP but the cage is a standard SFP slot; RJ45 auto-negotiates 10/100/1000Mbps, fiber side runs 1000Mbps full-duplex (1000Base-SX/LX) — both graded eth-1g. Link Fault Pass-through (LFP) DIP switch present but is a control feature, not a physical I/O connector. Sourced from the official StarTech instruction manual (PDF hosted on startech.com's CDN); the interactive product/spec page at startech.com/en-us/networking-io/mcm1110mmlc is JS-rendered and did not yield readable spec text via fetch, so the manual PDF was used as the authoritative source instead.

ports.name: Fiber (Mini-GBIC/SFP) Port
ports.note: Pre-installed with a 1000Base-SX (850nm) multimode Gigabit SFP transceiver module with duplex LC connectors; slot accepts any MSA-compliant Gigabit SFP (1000Base-SX or 1000Base-LX), not 10/100Mbps modules.

ports.name: DC input port
ports.note: 5V DC input from included universal (NA/EU/UK/AU) external power adapter.
